audit_roleEligibility: Change who may hold a role
audit_roleAppointment: Change which roles this one may appoint
grants_organizationalHint: Only grants inside what you administer are shown here
grants_confinedHint: Granted through one object and managed where that object is
grants_revokeHint: They keep every other role they hold. Granting it again is a separate act.
grants_anchorUnavailable: No unit can be chosen right now
grants_coverageSubtree: That unit and everything under it
grants_refusedOrgType: Not for this kind of unit
grants_nonePersonDisabled: Enable the user before granting them a role
grants_noneRefusedUserType: Their user type cannot hold the roles below
grants_noneRefusedAuthority: You cannot appoint the roles below; ask whoever appoints them
grants_noneRefusedMixed: The roles below cannot be granted right now
grants_noneRefusedUnit: The roles below do not fit here; try another unit
grants_reachUnitOnly: At this unit you may grant for the unit alone
grants_reachOutside: You cannot grant roles at this unit; try another
grants_noneTenant: You have no role to grant across the whole tenant
grants_noneUnit: You have no role to grant at this unit; try another
grants_administratorBody: They will be able to do everything, including granting and revoking any role
permission_roleEscalate: Define roles beyond your own authority
permissionHint_roleEscalate: Put a permission into a role without holding it yourself.
permission_grantRead: View role assignments in the organization
permission_grantManage: Manage role assignments in the organization
permissionHint_roleAppointmentManage: Configure the roles that each role is allowed to appoint.
roles_hint: Maintain permissions, who may hold a role, and which roles it appoints.
roles_tenantGroupHint: in effect across the whole tenant
roles_newHint: A role starts as a draft. Give it permissions and say who may hold it, then activate it.
roles_standingMeaning: Switched off, a role stops taking effect and keeps its configuration and its grants. Not grantable means no new grants; the ones already made are untouched
roles_grantedBefore: Already granted, so it can only be disabled
roles_grantedBeforeDisabled: Already granted, so it cannot be deleted
roles_catalogOrgOnly: Only the permissions a per-unit role can carry are listed
roles_catalogTenantOnly: Only the permissions a tenant-wide role can carry are listed
roles_memberLine: {holders, plural, =0 {nobody holds it} one {1 holder} other {# holders}} · appointed by {appointers, plural, =0 {no role} one {1 role} other {# roles}}
roles_askStatusBody: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody holds it yet.} one {# grant gains or loses what it allows at once.} other {# grants gain or lose what it allows at once.}}
roles_askGrantBody: Grants already made stay as they are; this decides whether new ones can be made.
roles_leaveTabBody: Save them, discard them, or stay and keep editing.
field_eligibilityAnyoneBody: Somebody of any user type may be granted this role
field_eligibilityListedBody: Only people of the ticked types may be granted it. With none ticked, nobody can hold it
field_anchorAnywhereBody: It may be held at a unit of any kind
field_anchorListedBody: It may be held only at units of the ticked kinds
nodeUsage_grantHistory: Withdrawn role grants kept as history
roles_exemptHint: The tenant administrator role is not restricted by user type.
roles_everyPermission: Carries whatever this deployment serves, so there is nothing to tick.
roles_grantableHint: Appointment authority in force: holders appoint exactly these offices, within where they administer grants.
roles_grantableNeedsManage: Give this role grant administration first; only then can it appoint anybody.
roles_confirmPermissionsBody: This takes effect immediately for {holders, plural, =0 {no current holders} one {1 current holder} other {# current holders}}, and {appointers, plural, =0 {no role} one {1 role} other {# roles}} appointing this one will hand out the new duties from now on.
field_kindOrgHint: Granted at a unit, and applies there or across its subtree.
field_kindTenantHint: Granted once, in force across the whole tenant.
field_allowedUserTypes: User types that may hold it
field_allowedOrgTypes: Kinds of unit where the duty applies
field_anyUserType: May be granted to any user type
field_anyOrgType: This duty applies at any kind of node
roles_systemHint: The tenant administrator role is fixed: it cannot be disabled, deleted or rewritten.
error_roleConflict: A role with that code or name already exists.
error_roleIsSystem: System roles cannot be changed this way.
error_roleHasGrantHistory: This role has been granted before, so it can only be disabled.
error_roleNeedsEligibility: An active role needs at least one eligible user type, and an organization role a node type.
error_roleAnchorMismatch: Refresh and try again: the role was edited as the other kind of role.
error_grantStranded: {assignmentCount, plural, one {# existing grant would} other {# existing grants would}} no longer qualify.
error_grantNotEligible: {reason, select, roleUnassignable {That role cannot be granted right now.} userDisabled {A disabled user cannot be granted a role.} userType {That role is not available to this user type.} orgType {That role cannot be anchored at this kind of node.} tenantRoleAnchored {A tenant-wide role can only be granted across the whole organization.} orgRoleUnanchored {An organization role must be granted at a node.} other {That grant is not allowed.}}
error_tenantAdminRequired: Only a tenant administrator may grant or revoke that role.
error_accessTargetRequired: That permission is checked against an organization node.
error_grantRuleRefused: None of your roles may appoint people to this one, so you cannot grant or revoke it.
error_grantUserNotFound: That user is not in this tenant.
error_grantNodeNotFound: That organization node is not in this tenant.
error_roleVersionConflict: Someone else changed this role. Reload and try again.
error_roleNotDraft: Only a draft role can be activated.
error_roleTargetMismatch: {count, plural, one {# permission does} other {# permissions do}} not fit this kind of role.
error_permissionNotFound: {count, plural, one {# permission is} other {# permissions are}} not available.
error_roleEscalationRefused: A role cannot be given {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}} you do not hold yourself.
error_grantEscalationRefused: Granting yourself that role would add authority you do not hold.
error_roleAppointmentInvalid: {reason, select, self {A role cannot appoint itself.} cycle {That would make the appointment relations circular.} kind {A role may only appoint roles of its own kind.} other {The role needs grant administration before it can appoint anybody.}}
error_grantResourceBound: This grant holds within one {namespace} {type} only and is withdrawn where that object is administered.
error_lastAdministrator: The tenant would be left without an administrator who can still sign in.
